CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `notifications` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `type` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `title` varchar(200) NOT NULL,
  `body` text NOT NULL,
  `linkUrl` varchar(500),
  `relatedId` int,
  `isRead` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX `notif_userId_idx` (`userId`),
  INDEX `notif_isRead_idx` (`isRead`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `offers` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `listingId` int NOT NULL,
  `buyerId` int NOT NULL,
  `sellerId` int NOT NULL,
  `sellerProfileId` int NOT NULL,
  `offerPriceHkd` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL,
  `message` text,
  `status` enum('pending','accepted','rejected','expired','cancelled') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `expiresAt` timestamp NOT NULL,
  `respondedAt` timestamp,
  `rejectionReason` text,
  `orderId` int,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX `offer_listingId_idx` (`listingId`),
  INDEX `offer_buyerId_idx` (`buyerId`),
  INDEX `offer_sellerId_idx` (`sellerId`),
  INDEX `offer_status_idx` (`status`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `listingReports` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `listingId` int NOT NULL,
  `reporterId` int NOT NULL,
  `reason` enum('fake_item','wrong_description','prohibited_item','scam','other') NOT NULL,
  `details` text,
  `status` enum('pending','reviewed','dismissed','actioned') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `adminNote` text,
  `reviewedAt` timestamp,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX `lr_listingId_idx` (`listingId`),
  INDEX `lr_reporterId_idx` (`reporterId`),
  INDEX `lr_status_idx` (`status`)
);

ALTER TABLE `sellerProfiles` MODIFY COLUMN `isActive` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true;
